title: mirql Event Envelope v1
description: Canonical, append-only, hash-chained and Ed25519-signed event envelope. Every number in the document (including nested payload fields) must be a safe integer (Law 17); the `type`/`writer.ns` pair is gated by the single-writer ACL (Law 3).

id.description: ULID (Crockford Base32) event identifier; monotonic per writer.

epoch.description: Configuration epoch the event was produced under.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock timestamp taken at emission.

type.description: Dotted domain event type, e.g. `job.enqueued`; gated by the single-writer ACL (Law 3).

writer.description: Identity of the writer that emitted and signed the event.

idempotency_key.description: Writer-scoped key making retries of the same intent dedupable.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event in this tenant's log (hash chaining).

payload.description: Free-form domain payload; every nested number must be a safe integer (Law 17).

hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the envelope without `hash` and `sig`.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (base64url, 64 raw bytes) over the UTF-8 bytes of `hash`.
